items.text: Unsloth released smaller DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 quantizations from 1-bit to 4-bit, letting the 3-bit build run on 128GB of RAM and 1-bit on 96GB.
items.text_zh: Unsloth 放出 DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 的更小量化版本，从 1-bit 到 4-bit 全覆盖，3-bit 可在 128GB 内存上跑，1-bit 只需 96GB。

items.text: Replit turned on a Model Selector that now includes open-weight models, letting users trade off intelligence, cost and speed per task.
items.text_zh: Replit 上线模型选择器，首次纳入开放权重模型，用户可按任务在智能水平、成本与速度之间自行权衡。

items.text: Character.AI premiered the official trailer for Eden Fall, an AI-made microdrama series about players trapped inside a game world.
items.text_zh: Character.AI 发布 AI 制作短剧《Eden Fall》官方预告，讲述玩家被困于游戏世界内部的故事。

items.text: OpenAI said GPT-5.4 and GPT-5.4 mini will stop working for ChatGPT-signed-in users on August 31, remaining available only through the API.
items.text_zh: OpenAI 宣布 8 月 31 日起，GPT-5.4 与 GPT-5.4 mini 将不再面向 ChatGPT 登录用户提供，仅保留 API 通道。

items.text: Simon Willison and Jesse Vincent's Prime Radiant lab open-sourced smevals, a small YAML-driven suite for grading models, prompts and harnesses side by side.
items.text_zh: Simon Willison 与 Jesse Vincent 的 Prime Radiant 实验室开源 smevals：用 YAML 定义的小型评测套件，可并排评分模型、提示词与 harness。

items.text: OpenAI added an Activity view to the ChatGPT desktop app that gathers conversations needing attention and recent updates across a user's work.
items.text_zh: OpenAI 为 ChatGPT 桌面端新增 Activity 视图，集中呈现需要用户处理的对话与各项工作的最新进展。

items.text: Baseten opened Qwen3-TTS supervised fine-tuning for voice cloning on its training platform, claiming 16% faster time-to-first-audio than rival cloning tools.
items.text_zh: Baseten 在其训练平台开放 Qwen3-TTS 监督微调用于声音克隆，称首音延迟比同类克隆工具快 16%。

items.text: AWS launched an Agentic Catalog experience in Amazon Quick, where an agent finds tables by natural language and bulk-creates catalog-connected datasets with inherited metadata.
items.text_zh: AWS 在 Amazon Quick 推出 Agentic Catalog 体验：智能体以自然语言检索数据表，批量创建挂接目录的数据集并自动继承元数据。

items.text: Google AI Studio said roughly 800,000 people pre-ordered its iOS and Android app, which lets developers build software from a phone.
items.text_zh: Google AI Studio 表示其 iOS 与安卓应用预约人数约 80 万，该应用让开发者可以直接用手机构建软件。

items.text: NVIDIA released Spatial-IQ, a diagnostic benchmark where humans count stacked boxes with 82.1% accuracy while the best multimodal model manages just 17.7%.
items.text_zh: 英伟达发布诊断性基准 Spatial-IQ：人类数堆叠方块（含被遮挡的）准确率 82.1%，而最强多模态模型仅 17.7%。

items.text: The major record labels proposed new chart rules designed to keep fully AI-generated tracks from flooding official music rankings.
items.text_zh: 三大唱片公司提出新的榜单规则，旨在阻止全 AI 生成的“垃圾歌曲”涌入官方音乐排行榜。

items.text: The European Commission opened bids for up to seven AI gigafactories, pairing €10 billion of public money with at least €20 billion in private investment.
items.text_zh: 欧盟委员会开放最多七座 AI 超级工厂的申报，以 100 亿欧元公共资金撬动至少 200 亿欧元私人投资。

items.text: Smallest.ai raised a $13 million Series A led by Seligman Ventures for near-zero-latency voice models that listen and speak simultaneously.
items.text_zh: Smallest.ai 完成 1300 万美元 A 轮融资，由 Seligman Ventures 领投，主打近乎零延迟、可边听边说的语音模型。

items.text: PixVerse showed its Depth Map Control working with Canvas, reconstructing a reference shot's spatial structure to layer foregrounds and exaggerate scale.
items.text_zh: PixVerse 展示 Depth Map Control 与 Canvas 联动：重建参考画面的空间结构，做出层叠前景与更强的景深与尺度感。

items.text: xAI upgraded Grok Imagine Video 1.5 with up to seven image references, voice consistency across scenes, prompt-only text-to-video and native 1080p output.
items.text_zh: xAI 升级 Grok Imagine Video 1.5：最多支持七张参考图、跨镜头声音一致性、纯文本生视频，并原生输出 1080p。

items.text: Runway said Grok Imagine Video 1.5 is now available inside its platform, letting creators run xAI's video model alongside Runway's own tools.
items.text_zh: Runway 宣布 Grok Imagine Video 1.5 已上线其平台，创作者可与 Runway 自有工具搭配使用 xAI 的视频模型。

items.text: Fei-Fei Li's World Labs acquired SceniX, shifting physical-AI training from collecting real-world data toward generating synthetic worlds at scale.
items.text_zh: 李飞飞旗下 World Labs 收购 SceniX，物理 AI 训练正从「采集真实数据」转向大规模「造世界」。

items.text: A just-departed OpenAI employee publicly urged colleagues to sell equity now rather than wait for an IPO, warning about valuation risk.
items.text_zh: 一位刚离职的 OpenAI 员工公开喊话前同事：想套现就赶紧套，别等 IPO，并提示估值风险。

items.text: Jensen Huang said he had avoided X because he is introverted, but now feels he must speak up publicly for AI.
items.text_zh: 黄仁勋称此前不玩 X 是因为自己太内向，如今为了 AI 必须站出来公开发声。

items.text: L'Oréal made its WAIC debut with a generative AI beauty adviser and hair-styling smart mirror, saying 73,000 staff finished generative AI training.
items.text_zh: 欧莱雅首次亮相 WAIC，展示生成式 AI 美妆顾问与美发魔镜，并称已有 7.3 万名员工完成生成式 AI 培训。

items.text: LMArena said DeepSeek-V4-Flash-High scored 1,586 in the Frontend Code Arena, ranking seventh overall and third among open models while reshaping the Pareto frontier.
items.text_zh: LMArena 称 DeepSeek-V4-Flash-High 在前端代码竞技场得 1586 分，总榜第七、开源第三，并重塑了性价比帕累托前沿。

items.text: Ollama put DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 on its cloud, giving local-first users hosted access to the release's upgraded agentic capabilities.
items.text_zh: Ollama 已在其云端上线 DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731，让本地优先的用户也能直接调用这一版增强的智能体能力。

items.text: Simon Willison said stateless MCP renewed his interest in the protocol, prompting him to build mcp-explorer and datasette-mcp.
items.text_zh: Simon Willison 表示无状态 MCP 重新激起了他对该协议的兴趣，并由此写出了 mcp-explorer 与 datasette-mcp。

items.text: Willison also released llm-mcp-client 0.1a0, an alpha plugin that lets his LLM command-line tool call tools from MCP servers.
items.text_zh: Willison 同时发布 llm-mcp-client 0.1a0 预览版插件，让其 LLM 命令行工具可以调用 MCP 服务器提供的工具。

items.text: China's national finals for fully teleoperation-free robot competition opened in Beijing, with more than 200 teams competing for the title.
items.text_zh: 全程无遥操机器人比赛全国决赛在北京开赛，200 多支队伍同场竞技冲击冠军。

items.text: LlamaIndex said it will exhibit at Ai4 in Las Vegas on August 4-6, with Jerry Liu speaking and a booth on the expo floor.
items.text_zh: LlamaIndex 宣布将于 8 月 4 至 6 日参展拉斯维加斯 Ai4 大会，Jerry Liu 将发表演讲，并在展区设置展台。

items.text: Genspark recapped a community build night at its Palo Alto headquarters, hosted by a Bay Area member of its Genspark Genius program.
items.text_zh: Genspark 回顾了在帕洛阿尔托总部举办的社区共建之夜，由其湾区「Genspark Genius」成员主持。

items.text: Sakana AI opened sign-ups for Sakana AI Insider, a subscriber channel for updates from the Tokyo research lab.
items.text_zh: Sakana AI 开放「Sakana AI Insider」订阅登记，作为这家东京研究实验室对外发布动态的渠道。
